mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_model_metric (model_id, metric_time, latency_ms, throughput_qps, accuracy, success_rate, call_count, kb_hit_avg, metric_source) VALUES (#{modelId}, IFNULL(#{metricTime}, NOW()), #{latencyMs}, #{throughputQps}, #{accuracy}, #{successRate}, IFNULL(#{callCount}, 0), #{kbHitAvg}, IFNULL(#{metricSource}, 'SAMPLE'))
